name: prompts
description: A prompt editor tab for .prompt.md files: "Prompts: New Prompt" opens a draft, Refine rewrites it with a locally installed AI CLI (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, or a custom command), and the first save names the file from its content. Existing prompts open via the FILES-tree "Edit Prompt" menu item.

prompts.provider.description: Which locally installed AI CLI refines prompts and suggests filenames.

prompts.binaryPath.description: Override the selected provider's binary (name on PATH, or an absolute path). Empty uses the provider's default (claude / codex / gemini). Ignored for the custom provider.

prompts.model.description: Model passed to the provider CLI (--model for claude, -m for codex/gemini). Empty uses the CLI's default. Ignored for the custom provider.

prompts.customCommand.description: Custom provider only: a shell command line that receives the instruction plus prompt as its single trailing argument and prints the result, e.g. `my-llm --quiet`.

prompts.refineInstruction.default: Rewrite the following prompt so it is clearer, more specific, and better structured for an AI coding agent. Keep the author's intent and every concrete detail; do not invent requirements. Reply with ONLY the rewritten prompt - no preamble, no commentary, no code fences.
prompts.refineInstruction.description: The instruction sent to the AI CLI when you press Refine in the prompt editor.

prompts.directory.description: Where new prompts are saved, relative to the active session's working directory.
